title: Three Fridays and One Short Counter
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：grocery　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grocery 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the shopkeeper ① kept a grocery that no neighbour on the row would have described, and he said the keeping was the whole of the Friday. The ② grocery, meaning the shop itself and not the stall, ran three Fridays and stayed undescribed in the book; a grocery, he said, is the only thing on a row that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ grocery on that row had the same short counter beside it, and the ④ grocery at the far corner, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A grocery, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the shopkeeper said the describing is the part that fills three Fridays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grocery was the whole of the matter, meaning the trade and not the shop. The ⑥ grocery, meaning the trade and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grocery, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both a shop and a trade. He said the trade is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ grocery had become a line in a lease, and the lease had become an argument about the short counter. The ⑧ grocery of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in November, was one row and three Fridays of describing; grocery, he said, is either the one at the far corner or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grocery I remember is the one described in the lease, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest on the row. A ⑩ grocery, my mother said in 1970, is the only one that improves by being described; every grocery, she said, is a trade that has agreed to look like a shop. She said the trade was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 食品杂货店（指街上每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 食品杂货店（指那家铺子本身，与货摊相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep a grocery 开一家杂货店
D. n. 杂货店（指留给孩子们学着看的那一角）
E. n. 杂货生意（抽象总称，指一条街的杂货之事）
F. n. 杂货店（指租约里写到、被记录过的那一家）
G. n. 日用杂货（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 杂货（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept a grocery that no neighbour on the row would have described
The grocery, meaning the shop itself and not the stall
the grocery at the far corner
the grocery was the whole of the matter
the grocery had become a line in a lease
The grocery of the whole thing
A grocery, my mother said in 1970

answers.why: keep a grocery 意为“开一家杂货店”，1961 年那位店主开了街上没有一位邻居肯描述的一家杂货店。
grocery 意为“食品杂货店”，指那家铺子本身而不是货摊，它经过了三个星期五而在簿子上没有被描述。
grocery 意为“食品杂货店”，指街上每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一张矮矮的柜台。
grocery 意为“杂货店”，指最远那个拐角留给孩子们学着看的那一角，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grocery 意为“日用杂货”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这些杂货就是那件事的全部。
grocery 意为“杂货”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家铺子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grocery 意为“杂货店”，指租约里写到、被记录过的那一家，到 1966 年这一家成了租约里的一行。
grocery 意为“杂货生意”，店主十一月写道，整件事的杂货之事是一条街和三个星期五的描述。
grocery 意为“杂货店”，我记得的是租约里描述过的那一家，1968 年关了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一家。
grocery 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，杂货店是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的铺子。
